create_user_data_dir: create a user-specific data directory path for an application on the current platform
create_user_config_dir: create a user-specific config directory path for an application following XDG or platform conventions
create_user_cache_dir: create a user-specific cache directory path for an application with optional opinion suffix
create_user_state_dir: create a user-specific state directory path following XDG_STATE_HOME or platform conventions
create_user_log_dir: create a user-specific log directory path derived from cache or data directories
create_site_data_dir: create a shared system-wide data directory path for an application across all users
create_AppDirs_class: create an AppDirs wrapper class that provides property-based access to all application directory paths
